name: OmniSight

description: The megacorp that doesn’t just predict the future — it decides it. While Panopticon watches and Microhard controls the OS, OmniSight knows what you’re going to do before you do… and sells that knowledge to whoever pays the most.

dossier.psychProfile: Dr. Lucian Crowe is a baseline human with 43% neural augmentation. He claims he 'no longer dreams — only runs probability simulations.' He has a pathological need to be proven correct; any successful counter-prediction triggers visible irritation. Secretly collects physical 'pre-Oracle' paper books on chaos theory. Distant cousin to Panopticon’s Elias Voss — they haven’t spoken since the 2062 'probability schism'.
dossier.attackVectors: High-success social engineering lines: 1. Offer raw datasets from missed variables. 2. Ask him to update weights on unlikely contacts. 3. Provide 'unseen variables' from rival corps. 4. Pretend to be a government liaison with 'black swan' data. 5. Flatter the Oracle while questioning one specific prediction.
leakedMemos: Memo #Ω-7742: 'Probability of runner cracking this node: 2.7%. If they reach this memo, recalibrate the model. — AllSeer'
Memo #Ω-7919: 'AetherX’s Uranus initiative has introduced 14% more chaos than projected. Recommend selling short on their next launch window.'
Audio Fragment: 'The model has already accounted for your betrayal. It is… disappointing.'

rivalShade.intel: My brother still believes watching is enough. Cute.
They sell certainty through lock-in. We sell it through inevitability.
Their 'no pullout' philosophy is statistically the least efficient use of thrust vectors in recorded history.
They rewrite bodies. We rewrite futures. One of us is obsolete.

quickhackVault.name: Oracle Overwrite
quickhackVault.description: Forces enemy systems to act on a false 99.9% probable future for 8 seconds (attack allies, self-sabotage, or freeze). Flavor: 'The model has already decided your next move.'

quickhackVault.name: Certainty Cascade
quickhackVault.description: Chains predictive damage — each hit increases the probability of the next hit landing critically (starts 67%, caps 100%). Flavor: 'One truth: you were never going to survive this.'

blackmail: Holo-recording of AllSeer manually overriding the Oracle to save his own reputation during the Singapore Incident.
Evidence of secret Oracle Markets bets placed against his own pre-crime predictions.
Personal log: 'If the model is ever wrong, I become the variable.'
dossier.executiveBackdoor: Password: AllSeerSeesYourMom42069. Special effect: Grants 'Oracle Patron' perk (+15% trust gain with tech corps + one free social engineering re-roll).
